instructions:
1. Kneel on the floor in a tabletop position with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
2. Reach your right arm forward along the floor, palm up.
3. Sit your hips back toward your heels and press your chest down.
4. Feel the stretch along the right side of your back and hold for 15 to 30 seconds.
5. Return to the start and switch sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Sit the hips back to deepen the stretch through the lat.
2. Keep the reaching arm long and relaxed.
3. Breathe slowly and let the shoulder ease down.
4. Use a mat for knee comfort.

instructions:
1. Kneel on the machine with one knee on the pad and the working leg secured under the roller.
2. Hold the handles and keep your back flat.
3. Curl the working leg up by bending the knee and driving the heel toward your glutes.
4. Squeeze the hamstring at the top.
5. Lower the leg under control to the start, then switch sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your hips and back steady through the curl.
2. Drive the heel up rather than swinging the leg.
3. Exhale curling up, inhale lowering down.
4. Control the lowering phase fully.

instructions:
1. Kneel on the floor with knees hip-width apart and sit back onto your heels.
2. Swing your arms back and brace your core.
3. Swing the arms forward and explosively drive your hips up off your knees.
4. Bring your feet under you and land in a squat with feet shoulder-width apart.
5. Lower back down to the kneeling start position.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Use a hard arm swing to drive the jump.
2. Land softly on the forefeet with bent knees.
3. Keep knees tracking over the toes on landing.
4. Squeeze the glutes hard at the top of the drive.

instructions:
1. Kneel on the floor with palms flat on the ground.
2. Rotate your hands so the fingers point back toward your knees.
3. Keep the palms flat and the elbows straight.
4. Slowly shift your weight back toward your heels until you feel the stretch in the wrists and forearms.
5. Hold for 15 to 30 seconds, then ease forward to release.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the palms pressed flat through the stretch.
2. Shift back slowly to control the intensity.
3. Move hands closer to the knees if the stretch is too strong.
4. Breathe steadily and stay relaxed.

instructions:
1. Anchor one end of a barbell in a landmine or corner.
2. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the free end at chest level with one hand.
3. Brace your core and keep your back straight.
4. Press the bar forward and slightly up until the arm is fully extended.
5. Lower the bar under control back to chest level, then switch sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the core tight to resist twisting toward the working side.
2. Drive the bar forward and up, not just up.
3. Exhale on the press, inhale on the return.
4. Keep the wrist firm and the shoulder down.
